description: Add an optional, awaitable QuoteForm callback that notifies its parent after a successful in-form quote workflow update.
Invoke and await the parent callback after a successful detail-view send while the workflow action remains busy.
Invoke and await the parent callback after a successful detail-view resend while the workflow action remains busy.
Invoke and await the parent callback after a successful detail-view approval while the workflow action remains busy.
Do not invoke the parent callback when send, resend, or approve returns an action error, returns a permission error, or throws.
Allow QuotesTab.loadData to refresh an already-mounted view without entering the full initial-loading state or unmounting QuoteForm.
Wire QuoteForm's successful workflow callback in QuotesTab to the background loadData path so the quotes collection, status filters, and tab counts recompute from current server data.
Preserve the existing full loading treatment for initial data load and the existing refresh behavior of list-row quote actions.
